interface.signature: def fractionToDecimal(self, numerator: int, denominator: int) -> str

preconditions.description: The numerator must be between 1 and 2000 inclusive.
The denominator must be between 1 and 2000 inclusive.
The denominator must not be zero to avoid division by zero.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(numerator // denominator) if numerator % denominator == 0 else True
postconditions.description: If the numerator is divisible by the denominator, the output must be the integer value as a string.

postconditions.expression: stdout.startswith('0.') and '.' in stdout and '(' in stdout and ')' in stdout if numerator % denominator != 0 else True
postconditions.description: If the numerator is not divisible by the denominator, the output must be a decimal representation with the repeating part enclosed in parentheses.
The length of the output string must not exceed 100 characters.
